info.description: Proxy API used to build a Terraform provider.
info.title: SPX TF Proxy API

get.description: Returns the list of all disks by calling the SPX API.

post.description: Creates a new disk resource by calling the SPX API.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a disk by calling the SPX API.

put.description: Updates the name of a disk by calling the SPX API.

delete.description: Deletes a disk by calling the SPX API.

get.description: Returns the list of all EIPs by calling the SPX API.

post.description: Creates a new EIP resource by calling the SPX API.

get.description: Retrieves the details of an EIP by calling the SPX API.

put.description: Updates an EIP by calling the SPX API.

delete.description: Deletes an EIP by calling the SPX API and waits until it is actually gone.

get.description: Returns the list of all SSH keys by calling the SPX API.

post.description: Creates a new SSH key by calling the SPX API.

get.description: Retrieves the details of an SSH key by calling the SPX API.

delete.description: Deletes an SSH key by calling the SPX API.

get.description: Returns the list of all StorageClasses available for a given project and AZ.
Returns the list of all Subnets by calling the SPX API.

post.description: Creates a new Subnet resource by calling the SPX API. OrgaID, ProjectID and AZ must be provided in the URL.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a Subnet by calling the SPX API.

put.description: Updates a Subnet by calling the SPX API.

delete.description: Deletes a Subnet by calling the SPX API and waits until it is actually gone.

get.description: Returns the list of all VM types available for a given project and AZ.
Returns the list of all VPCs by calling the SPX API. OrgaID, ProjectID and AZ must be provided in the URL.

post.description: Creates a new VPC resource by calling the SPX API. OrgaID, ProjectID and AZ must be provided in the URL.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a VPC by calling the SPX API. OrgaID, ProjectID and AZ must be provided in the URL.

put.description: Updates the name of a VPC by calling the SPX API. OrgaID, ProjectID and AZ must be provided in the URL.

delete.description: Deletes a VPC by calling the SPX API. OrgaID, ProjectID and AZ must be provided in the URL.

subnetIds.description: SubnetIDs limits the security group to these subnets (empty = all subnets)

static_routes.description: StaticRoutes (update only): nil = existing routes kept, [] = all removed
